title: Her second Tommy Rockwell session in New York
summary: Humes recalls that her second session for Rockwell was made in New York, when she stayed with friends and went with Mr. and Mrs. Weaver.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Alright, let's move to the record session. So then John comes talking records to you, you must have been a bit thrilled about that, weren't you?
Yes I was. You know the second session I made with Mr. Rockwell I made in New York.
Yeah. No, I went with Mr. and Mrs. Weaver then.
